subject: [COMPANY] | Scaling your multimodal data pipelines
text:
Hi [NAME],

Was reading about your plans to advance core R&D and expand clinical
channels, post-raise. We started working with computer vision teams such as
Sewer AI, right around this same inflection point, when they were scaling
past early deployments and needed their data and model pipeline to keep up.

As [COMPANY] scales to more clinical settings and customers - the bottleneck
often shifts from cameras to data: labeling, curating, and iterating on
training data fast enough to keep up with new stool/urine imagery edge
cases that move the needle in model performance.

Encord is a multimodal data platform built for exactly that problem;
helping computer vision teams manage and improve training data at scale, so
model iteration doesn't become the thing slowing down deployment and path
to FDA approval.

If you could speed up model iteration, what would that mean for your goal
of speeding up model deployment, post-raise?

subject: [SENDER] patriciu mentioned we should chat | encord
text:
Hi [NAME],

Met your colleague Alexandru Patriciu at SRS this weekend, and he mentioned
you were the person I needed to impress at [COMPANY].

I noticed the two patent grants your group had earlier this year:
thrombectomy and interventional ultrasound. Both of those being rolled out
en masse relies on accurately labelled ground truth for your models.

Heads of AI, Robotics, & Imaging at leading teams like Stryker, Abbvie, and
Viz.ai came to Encord frustrated by the architecture of their existing
tooling limiting their ability to annotate complex modalities (4D DICOM,
video etc.) and to comply with the FDA's PCCP requirements.

The Encord platform enables them to curate and annotate vast volumes of
multimodal data across cross-functional teams, while Encord's network of
expert medical annotators provides the supporting taskforce.

Open to learning more?

subject: Autonomy at Eacon <> Encord
text:

I lead GTM efforts for Physical AI at Encord
<[LINK]>
where we partner with some of the fastest growing companies across ADAS/AV,
